values.note: NPS gives 279 individual sites plus 39 electric sites; the recreation.gov catalog lists 313 individual sites (35 electric) plus 4 group sites. Nearly all are back-in; two are pull-through. The 45-ft limit is the RV and tow vehicle together.

values.note: No more than 30 nights a year across all the park's campgrounds.

booking.source: NPS API ('Campsites are reservable on Recreation.gov ... up to six months in advance. The maximum stay permitted at Gros Ventre Campground is 14 nights, and the maximum cumulative stay between all Grand Teton National Park campgrounds is 30 nights'; numberOfSitesFirstComeFirstServe 0) + recreation.gov rules (maxConsecutiveStay 14), read 2026-11-20

discounts.source: recreation.gov 247661 overview ('Please note this is a concession run campground and sites are not eligible for America the Beautiful or Senior Pass discounts'), read 2026-11-20

note: Grand Teton's largest campground, run by the park concessioner, on sage and cottonwood flats beside the Gros Ventre River near Kelly, SE corner of the park; the river is a short walk but no site is on it. Some sites look to the Teton Range and Blacktail Butte. Generators only in loops A, B, C and along the East Corridor. --Claude
summary: NPS API + rec.gov 247661: 313 sites (+4 group), 35 electric 30/50A, no water/sewer hookups, flush toilets, dump, no showers; $59 dry / $89 electric (2027; stored high $78 wrong); 2027 season 04-28..10-09; reservable only, 14-night limit; concession -> senior discount false (policy contradiction). Not waterfront kept. Pin ~160 m from the site centroid, fine. Phone empty -> 307-543-2811; website general campgrounds page -> the Gros Ventre page.
